backlog_trend.title: Parcel Backlog Trend
backlog_trend.description_high: Pending and blocked parcel queue is growing over time
backlog_trend.description_low: Parcel backlog is steadily clearing or stable

processing_rate.title: Acquisition Processing Rate
processing_rate.description_low: Clearance velocity is stagnant or below target

stage_complexity.title: Workflow Stage Complexity
stage_complexity.description_high: High proportion of parcels in legally complex stages (Objection, R&R, Award)
stage_complexity.description_low: Parcels predominantly in early survey or final closure stages

district_capacity.title: District Administrative Capacity
district_capacity.description_high: Adequate officer staffing relative to active parcel volume
district_capacity.description_low: Severe officer overload / staffing deficit in project districts

sla_breach_rate.title: Regulatory SLA Breach Rate
sla_breach_rate.description_high: Substantial portion of active acquisition stages have breached statutory deadlines
sla_breach_rate.description_low: Workflow stages largely proceeding within statutory time limits

avg_days_per_stage.title: Average Duration Per Stage
avg_days_per_stage.description_high: Prolonged dwell time across procedural workflow stages

dispute_ratio.title: Litigation & Dispute Ratio
dispute_ratio.description_high: Elevated proportion of contested parcels or formal objections
dispute_ratio.description_low: Minimal legal challenges or ownership disputes

compensation_pending_ratio.title: Pending Compensation Disbursement Ratio
compensation_pending_ratio.description_high: Significant backlog of unpaid compensation funds awaiting disbursement
compensation_pending_ratio.description_low: Compensation payouts are disbursed promptly following award

snapshot_count.title: Timeline Observation Depth
snapshot_count.description_high: Deep multi-month snapshot history available for trend analysis
